stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Three totals, and the wrong lines.

stations.title: Closing time
stations.text: The tickets file read by eye, slip by slip.

stations.title: The report
stations.text: Repairs, minutes, parts, and the bad lines.

captions: Ambrose wants three totals from the day's tickets file, and the lines that are wrong.
Today he reads the tickets file by eye at closing time and adds it up himself.
You read each line into a repair, refuse the bad ones by number, and write a report.
The day is read from the file, its bad lines named, and the totals land in a report.
Ambrose's closing time is one run now: the tickets in, the report out, every slip found.
